verdict.rationale: Ollama's core product is a locally run model runtime. It installs with a one-line script, serves a local REST API, and the docs state that nothing run locally leaves the machine. Community users independently confirm running it on their own hardware, including AMD GPUs via ROCm containers, Linux inference, and embedding it into their own products. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of the open-source license, and some features are cloud-only or platform-limited (larger cloud models, image generation only on macOS).
